slot.archive.exit.note: Why a slot is kept, not removed: its archive command failed. {code} is its exit code.

slot.archive.noStart.note: Why a slot is kept, not removed: its archive command couldn't be started.

slot.archive.notEnded.text: processes it started could not be ended
slot.archive.notEnded.note: Why a slot is kept, not removed: its archive command ended, but processes it started still run.

slot.archive.timedOut.note: Why a slot is kept, not removed: its archive command reached its time limit.

slot.check.noBase.note: Why Combwork can't tell whether a slot's work is merged: it shares no history with its target branch.

slot.check.noBranch.note: Why Combwork can't tell whether a slot's work is merged: its target branch doesn't exist. {target} is its name.

slot.check.noTarget.note: Why Combwork can't tell whether a slot's work is merged: the project has no default branch.

slot.error.closed.note: A slot's setup or preparation stopped: its workspace closed. Kept on the slot as its error.

slot.error.deleting.note: Why a slot isn't ready: the project's Delete holds its slots (#1447). The end of slot.refusal.notReady ("… isn't ready (…)").

slot.error.gitRead.note: A slot's setup or preparation error: git couldn't read a branch or HEAD. {what} is the branch's name, or HEAD.

slot.error.identityUnread.text: its workspace's identity couldn't be read
slot.error.identityUnread.note: A slot's setup error (HI-2795): a jj workspace was made but its store, name or folder ids couldn't be read, so Combwork won't use or remove it.

slot.error.interrupted.note: A slot's setup error, kept on the slot, when the setup was taken over from a Combwork that is gone (#1429). Read by agents and in the log.

slot.error.notListed.text: its folder is there but git does not list it as a worktree
slot.error.notListed.note: A slot's setup error: its folder exists but isn't a worktree git knows, so Combwork leaves it alone.

slot.error.opLost.note: An operation on a slot stopped because another took the slot over (#1429). Caught by the pool; in the log if it ever escapes.

slot.error.setupExit.note: A slot's setup error: its setup command failed. {code} is its exit code.

slot.error.setupNoStart.note: A slot's setup error: its setup command couldn't be started. {command} is the command.

slot.error.setupNotEnded.text: processes its setup started could not be ended
slot.error.setupNotEnded.note: A slot's setup error: its setup command ended, but processes it started are still running.

slot.error.setupTimedOut.text: its setup ran out of time
slot.error.setupTimedOut.note: A slot's setup error: its setup command reached its time limit (Settings → Advanced).

slot.error.worktreeAdd.note: A slot's setup error: `git worktree add` failed. {error} is git's first line, else failed.

slot.hold.byHand.text: its slot {slot} is free, for a Resume by hand
slot.hold.byHand.note: As slot.hold.draining: the slot is free, and the user resumes the conversation.

slot.hold.changed.text: its slot {slot} changed since it ran
slot.hold.changed.note: As slot.hold.draining: the slot's checkout changed since the conversation ran there.

slot.hold.draining.text: its last session there is still ending
slot.hold.draining.note: Why a builder's conversation in its slot can't resume yet: the end of slot.place.cantResume.

slot.hold.gone.note: As slot.hold.draining: the slot's folder is gone.

slot.hold.otherSlot.note: As slot.hold.draining: one agent, one slot (HI-1762).

slot.hold.otherWork.text: its slot {slot} holds other work now
slot.hold.otherWork.note: As slot.hold.draining: the slot was lent for other work since.

slot.hold.reviews.note: As slot.hold.draining: the agent is reviewing.

slot.jj.filesUnread.note: HI-3003: why a jj slot couldn't be prepared for its card: jj couldn't say whether its working copy has changes. The jj counterpart of slot.prepare.filesUnread.

slot.jj.forgetFailed.note: HI-3003: why a jj slot is kept, not removed: jj's removal of its workspace refused and said nothing. The jj counterpart of slot.remove.failed.

slot.jj.lineUnread.note: HI-3003: a jj slot's setup or preparation error: jj couldn't read the card's line or the target bookmark. {what} is its name. The jj counterpart of slot.error.gitRead.

slot.jj.noTarget.note: HI-3003: why Combwork can't tell whether a jj slot's work is in its target: the project has no target bookmark (Version Control → Workflow's Work merges into). The jj counterpart of slot.check.noTarget.

slot.jj.notListed.text: its folder is there but jj does not list it as a workspace
slot.jj.notListed.note: HI-3003: a jj slot's setup error: its folder exists but isn't a workspace jj knows, so Combwork leaves it alone. The jj counterpart of slot.error.notListed.

slot.jj.prepareFailed.text: jj couldn't prepare {slot} for the card: {error}
slot.jj.prepareFailed.note: HI-3003: why a jj slot couldn't be prepared for its card: jj refused or failed the step that puts its workspace on the card's base. {error} is jj's first line, else failed. The jj counterpart of slot.prepare.switchFailed: names no git or switch.

slot.jj.workspaceAdd.note: HI-3003: a jj slot's setup error: `jj workspace add` failed. {error} is jj's first line, else failed. The jj counterpart of slot.error.worktreeAdd.

slot.jj.workspaceUnread.note: HI-3003: why a jj slot couldn't be prepared for its card: jj couldn't read the slot's workspace (what it is bound to). The jj counterpart of slot.prepare.branchUnread: names no git or branch.

slot.kept.busy.note: HI-2995: why a kept slot (slot.refusal.kept) is not lent back now: an operation, a session or a process holds it.

slot.kept.gone.note: HI-2995: why a kept slot (slot.refusal.kept) can't be lent back: its folder was deleted.

slot.kept.other.note: HI-2995: why a kept slot (slot.refusal.kept) is not the one lent: the start named another slot.

slot.kept.stale.text: its binding isn't this card's at the folder's generation any more: recover or remove the slot
slot.kept.stale.note: HI-2995: why a kept slot (slot.refusal.kept) can't be lent back: jj's record of the slot no longer names the card.

slot.laneEnd.merged.note: A card in slot.laneEnd.note's list: merged, with its merge commit's first 12 characters.

slot.laneEnd.more.note: The end of slot.laneEnd.note's list, past its first 20 cards. {count} is digits.

slot.laneEnd.notMerged.note: A card in slot.laneEnd.note's list: not merged.

slot.laneEnd.note.text: {abandoned, select, yes {Lane {lane} was abandoned} other {Lane {lane} is finished}}{listed, select, yes {: {list}} other {}}. Your session ends once this turn does; Combwork resumes it for your next lane. Close the lane's work in your reply, then end your turn.
slot.laneEnd.note.note: The note a lane's builder is given as its lane ends (HI-1706): each card (slot.laneEnd.merged or notMerged, joined by "; "), and that its session ends with its turn. Cut at 2000 characters.

slot.place.cantResume.text: Combwork can't give {card} to {agent} yet: its conversation in {slot} can't resume now ({why}).
slot.place.cantResume.note: A card's notice and its builder's wake: the builder's conversation in its slot can't resume yet. {why} is one of slot.hold.*, or why the slot is held. Kept on the card, so said in the Default.

slot.place.notReady.note: Why a builder's start ended (a card's stall): its slot couldn't be prepared for the card. Kept, so said in the Default.

slot.place.notReadyFor.note: A card's notice and its builder's wake: its slot couldn't be prepared for it. Kept on the card, so said in the Default.

slot.place.resumeEnded.text: its conversation in {slot} didn't resume ({tries} tries): {why}
slot.place.resumeEnded.note: Why a builder's start ended (a card's stall): resuming its conversation failed every try. Kept, so said in the Default.

slot.place.resumeFailed.text: Combwork couldn't resume {agent}'s conversation in {slot} for {card} (three tries): {why}. Resume {agent} from Sessions, or start it fresh, and Combwork gives it {card}.
slot.place.resumeFailed.note: A card's notice and its builder's wake: resuming its conversation failed three times. Kept on the card, so said in the Default.

slot.prepare.branchUnread.note: Why a slot couldn't be prepared for its card: git couldn't read the branch it is on.

slot.prepare.busy.text: {slot} is busy: being set up, a command of its still running, or another session in it
slot.prepare.busy.note: Why a slot's preparation for its card waits (#1438): something else has the slot now.

slot.prepare.filesUnread.note: Why a slot couldn't be prepared for its card: git couldn't say whether it has changes.

slot.prepare.leaseEnded.note: Why a slot couldn't be prepared for its card: the lease it was lent under ended.

slot.prepare.stale.text: {slot} is stale: another jj workspace rewrote its working copy. The user can recover it with Recover… under Slots and copies
slot.prepare.stale.note: Why a jj slot couldn't be prepared for its card (HI-2913): another workspace rewrote its working-copy commit (a rebase of the card's commit, say), so its files are behind; recovering it is the user's action.

slot.prepare.switchFailed.note: Why a slot couldn't be prepared for its card: `git switch` failed. {error} is git's first line, else failed.

slot.prepare.takenOver.note: Why a slot's preparation for its card waits: another operation took the slot over (#1429).

slot.prepare.uncommitted.note: Why a slot couldn't be prepared for its card: switching its branch would lose changes.

slot.refusal.aSlot.note: The slot named in slot.refusal.notReady when the start named none and the project is being deleted ("a slot isn't ready (the project is being deleted)").

slot.refusal.agentLeased.text: this agent already builds in {slot} for {what}
slot.refusal.agentLeased.note: A start refused: one agent, one slot (HI-1762). {what} is the card's key or slot.refusal.lane.

slot.refusal.busy.text: {held, select, session {{slot} still has a session in it} process {{slot} still has a process running in it (a file or a folder in it open)} broker {{slot} still has a process running in it (a file or a folder in it open): Windows Sandbox's broker ({name}) is working in it{idle, select, yes {, with no Sandbox running} no {, with a Sandbox running} other {}}} other {{slot} has a session or a process in it}}
slot.refusal.busy.note: A start's wait: something still runs in a free slot, so it isn't lent (HI-2466: held, what: a session, a process, or not known). broker (HI-2467): Windows Sandbox's broker ({name}: its process name, such as WindowsSandboxServer) has the slot as its current folder; idle: yes, no Sandbox runs; no, one does; other, not known. Combwork tries again until it is free.

slot.refusal.inUse.note: A start's wait: the slot named is lent to another agent. {what} is the card's key or slot.refusal.lane.

slot.refusal.kept.text: {slot} holds this card's committed work from before it was put back, kept for it there: it gets that slot back, never a fresh one ({why})
slot.refusal.kept.note: HI-2995: a jj card's start refused while its own earlier work is kept in a slot that can't be lent back to it now. {why} is slot.kept.*.

slot.refusal.lane.note: What a slot is lent for when it is a lane, not a card: the end of slot.refusal.inUse and slot.refusal.agentLeased.

slot.refusal.noSlot.text: no slot free: the pool's {size} {count, plural, =1 {slot is} other {slots are}} in use
slot.refusal.noSlot.note: A start's wait: every slot of the pool is lent. {size} is the pool's size as digits; {count} the same number, choosing the plural.

slot.refusal.notReady.note: A start's wait or refusal: the slot isn't ready. {why} is its setup's error, else its state.

slot.refusal.setupFailed.note: A start refused: the slot's setup failed. {error} is why (one of slot.error.*, git's or the command's).

slot.refusal.warming.note: A start's wait: the slot's setup is running.

slot.release.both.text: {slot} is both kept for {agent} (kind: carried) and held by a run (kind: writer): say which to release.
slot.release.both.note: Release refused: the slot has both, and the call named neither. carried and writer are the kind argument's values.

slot.release.carriedChanged.text: {slot} changed meanwhile: it is no longer kept for {agent}. Look again.
slot.release.carriedChanged.note: Release of kind carried refused: the slot changed since it was looked at.

slot.release.confirm.text: Releasing {slot}'s writer needs confirm: '{' slot: "{slot}", run: "<its run>" '}', the slot and run the user agreed to release (list shows them).
slot.release.confirm.note: Release of kind writer refused: it needs the user's confirmation of the slot and run they were shown. The braces show the argument's shape.

slot.release.noSlot.text: No slot {slot} in this project{listed, select, yes { (its slots: {slots})} other {}}.
slot.release.noSlot.note: Release refused: the project has no slot of that name. {slots} lists the slots it has, when it has any.

slot.release.notCarried.text: {slot} isn't kept for an agent (no carried lease).
slot.release.notCarried.note: Release of kind carried refused: no agent keeps the slot.

slot.release.nothing.text: {slot} has nothing to release: it is kept for no agent and no run holds it.
slot.release.nothing.note: Release refused: the slot is neither kept for an agent nor held by a run.

slot.release.writerChanged.text: {slot} changed meanwhile: no run holds it now. Look again.
slot.release.writerChanged.note: Release of kind writer refused: the run that held the slot has gone since.

slot.remove.failed.note: Why a slot is kept, not removed: `git worktree remove` refused and said nothing.

slot.run.closed.note: A slot's or copy's setup error: its workspace closed before its command ran.

slot.run.noJob.note: A slot's or copy's setup error: the job its command runs in couldn't be made. {problem} is why.

slot.run.noSupervisor.text: Combwork's process supervisor isn't running, so it can't run a slot's commands
slot.run.noSupervisor.note: A slot's or copy's setup error: Combwork runs their commands in a job of its own, and can't now.

slot.start.leaseEnded.text: its slot's lease {lease} ended while the start took it: the start tries again
slot.start.leaseEnded.note: A start's wait: the slot's lease ended between taking it and recording its target.

slot.start.ownSlotWaits.text: {agent}'s own slot {slot}, its run still there, {because}: this start waits for it rather than take a second slot
slot.start.ownSlotWaits.note: A start's wait (HI-1762): the builder's own run still writes in a slot that can't be taken over now. {because} is one of slot.takeover.*.

slot.takeover.busy.text: is being set up or changed
slot.takeover.busy.note: As slot.takeover.gone: an operation holds the slot.

slot.takeover.changed.text: changed while it was taken over
slot.takeover.changed.note: As slot.takeover.gone: the slot changed while the start took it over, twice.

slot.takeover.gone.note: Why the slot a builder's own run still writes in can't be taken over by its start (HI-1787): the end of slot.start.ownSlotWaits after the slot's name.

slot.takeover.holdsLease.text: can't be taken over while its agent holds another lease
slot.takeover.holdsLease.note: As slot.takeover.gone: one agent, one slot (HI-1762).

slot.takeover.job.text: has a command of its own running
slot.takeover.job.note: As slot.takeover.gone: a command of the slot's (its setup, an archive) runs.

slot.takeover.lent.note: As slot.takeover.gone: another lease has it.

slot.takeover.notReady.note: As slot.takeover.gone: the slot isn't lent. {state} is its state's id (ready, dirty…).

slot.takeover.otherCombwork.text: is held by another Combwork's run
slot.takeover.otherCombwork.note: As slot.takeover.gone: a run of another Combwork (another profile) holds it.

slot.takeover.otherRun.text: has another run in it now
slot.takeover.otherRun.note: As slot.takeover.gone: another run writes there now.
